name: Moto, Densetsu no Yuusha-tachi ...
source:
This is a novel adventure game based on the very popular RPG game, "Dragon Quest."

The main character is a monster in human shape who lives in a mountain cabin.
He went to a hunting and happened to meet a group of heroes who were injured.
Seeing him, they tried to fight against him to protect themselves in vain...

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE051842.html]DLsite English[/url]]
